headline: Gérard Depardieu To Face Trial Over 2018 Rape Of Charlotte Arnould
seoTitle: Gérard Depardieu to Stand Trial for Rape
metaDescription: A Paris appeals court has ruled that French actor Gérard Depardieu will stand trial regarding the 2018 rape of actress Charlotte Arnould.
aiSummaryBullets: A Paris appeals court confirmed that Gérard Depardieu will face trial on rape charges involving an incident from 2018.
The legal proceedings concern allegations brought by actress Charlotte Arnould, who was 22 at the time of the alleged event.
Separate from this trial, Depardieu and writer Michel Houellebecq are currently subject to an inquiry regarding gang-rape allegations.
aiContextParagraph: French actor Gérard Depardieu has been ordered to stand trial by a Paris appeals court following charges of raping actress Charlotte Arnould in 2018 at his home in Paris. The charges were initially filed in 2020 after the accuser, who was 22 years old at the time of the alleged incident, brought the case forward. Beyond this specific court-ordered trial, public reports indicate that authorities are conducting additional investigations involving Depardieu and the writer Michel Houellebecq. These separate inquiries relate to allegations of on-set gang rape and assault. The recent ruling from the appeals court solidifies the legal path forward regarding the 2018 case, while the broader allegations involving other public figures remain under scrutiny by law enforcement.
